alias_resolution_notes.subject: Thần Điện / Tòa Thánh

alias_resolution_notes.subject: Thánh Đô / Solaria
alias_resolution_notes.note: Both are used as central religious/political locations; B01 does not explicitly establish identity.

alias_resolution_notes.subject: Miller (scout) / Miller (blacksmith)
alias_resolution_notes.note: Chapter 3 introduces a missing scout named Miller; chapter 13 names an elderly blacksmith Miller and chapter 19 references Miller’s children. They are kept as separate entities until the source proves identity.

alias_resolution_notes.subject: Pháp trận Thượng Cổ dưới phế tích / Pháp trận tại tháp canh
alias_resolution_notes.note: Both are ancient teleportation-related structures in the northern escape route, but the source does not explicitly establish identity. Kept as structure-003 and structure-005.

alias_resolution_notes.subject: Vực Thẳm Răng Cưa / Hẻm Núi Răng Cưa
alias_resolution_notes.note: The names occur in adjacent survival sequences after the tower collapse, but are not explicitly declared to be the same geographic feature. Kept separate.

alias_resolution_notes.subject: Lăng Mộ Thượng Cổ / Lăng Mộ Quỷ Tộc
alias_resolution_notes.note: Chapters 30–36 use these names for the same northwestern Frostspine tomb/base, with continuous gate, halls, Valora forces, and lower levels. Consolidated as loc-018.

history.change: Elena treats Alan’s combat injury and monitors the strain caused by his broken mana core.
They coordinate tightly in combat, combining Elena’s chemical/medical knowledge with Alan’s mechanical swordsmanship.
A quiet caregiving scene shows mutual trust and personal affection, but the source does not explicitly label the relationship.
Elena says she will remain directly behind Alan during the coming defense, continuing their established combat-and-medical coordination.
Elena creates an opening against Roland, then escapes with Alan and Brand after Gregor’s last stand.
Elena continues treating Alan’s escalating Flash Surge damage while the refugees move underground.
Elena refuses to leave Alan alone at the tower and stays to provide battlefield support while civilians begin teleporting.
Alan deliberately activates the ancient array so Elena escapes while he remains behind; the tower collapse separates them.
While separated, both characters orient their survival decisions around finding/protecting the other.
Alan and Elena reunite in the old mine and immediately resume coordinated resistance and medical/combat support.
Elena actively shields the injured Alan and coordinates the final corrosive/steam defense while the fourth forge collapses.
Alan and Elena again cover each other during the gate breach, combining Thần Tinh sword strikes with Elena’s anti-mana projectiles to enter the ancient tomb.
Elena and Alan coordinate the dangerous sixth-level forge process: Alan supplies mechanical power while Elena controls the non-mana cooling/chemical treatment for the Thần Tinh charges.
After the western sabotage, Elena stitches and treats Alan’s worsening shoulder damage and explicitly frames keeping him physically functional as her responsibility.
During the stone-ice beetle attack, Elena identifies the queen’s mechanical weak point and chemically prepares Alan’s Thần Tinh blade, enabling a coordinated kill.
Elena re-stitches Alan’s reopened shoulder wound in the Solaria attic; Alan promises to bring her and the Oakhaven people home after the conflict, and they briefly clasp hands.
Gregor entrusts Alan with finding Miller and Jory.
Narration explicitly calls Gregor Alan’s foster father.
Gregor physically intervenes against a chitin creature threatening the injured Alan during the western defense.
Gregor sacrifices himself against Roland so Alan, Elena, Brand, and the refugees can escape; he explicitly entrusts Oakhaven’s future to Alan.
Alan teaches Toby footwork and tells him to read body movement rather than stare at the weapon.
Alan refers to Varian as his master and cites Varian’s view of Alistair.
Elena expresses hope and respect for Alistair as a rescuer.
Elena cites old medical records about Jericho to explain why she believes Alistair may still protect ordinary people.
Elena’s admiration is shaken when Roland attributes the grain seizure and cleansing campaign to Alistair’s needs and authority.
After directly seeing Temple equipment drain a living tree, Elena begins openly blaming Alistair for complicity, though his knowledge is not independently proven.
Elena explicitly says she no longer believes in a savior and that Oakhaven must save itself.
Elena states that Alistair is no longer a hero in her view and frames future opposition to him as necessary.
Elena directly confronts Alistair during the tower defense rather than treating him as a hoped-for rescuer.
Elena explicitly rejects Alistair’s utilitarian sacrifice logic after he says her power should be used to stabilize Solaria.
Alan hopes Alistair brings rescue rather than chains.
Alan says he will accept genuine purification but resist any attempt to seize Oakhaven’s winter food.
Alan interprets Roland’s edict as confirmation that Oakhaven is being sacrificed for Solaria and shifts from conditional skepticism toward active resistance.
Alan openly calls Alistair a false god while opposing the Temple assault.
Alan repeats a claim attributed to Varian that Alistair saw something beyond the sky and chose a destructive path; this claim remains unverified in-source at this point.
Alan and Alistair fight directly for the first time; Alistair destroys Alan’s ordinary short sword and seriously injures him.
Alan overloads the ancient teleportation array, creating a spatial rupture that severely damages/severs Alistair’s right-arm area before Alan falls into the chasm.
Brand tries to rescue Roger after Roger is seized; Alan stops him because the attack is being used as a lure.
Roland’s ultimatum places Alan and Oakhaven in direct opposition to Temple enforcement.
Alan and Roland fight directly at the forge; Alan briefly wounds Roland but is overwhelmed.
Alan wounds Roland with the Thần Tinh sword after Elena’s trap interrupts Roland’s siphoning lens; Roland survives and orders the forge purged.
Elena offers medical/water-detoxification knowledge in exchange for shelter and mutual defense; Bram accepts a survival alliance.
A very similar bargain is narrated again as though being established for the first time; the alliance itself remains explicit, but chronology is flagged as a narrative replay.
Bram is again shown cooperating with Alan and Elena at the ancient-tomb forge, though the repeated “first sword” forging is flagged as a narrative replay.
Elena removes a Temple siphoning device and treats Korgan’s poisoned wound without mana.
Korgan identifies himself, provides intelligence about Valora and the auxiliary pillars, and gives Elena/Alan a recognition token for safe passage.
Elena proposes an equal exchange of anti-Temple medical/chemical knowledge for Demon ore and forge support; Valora accepts.
The alliance is validated in a joint ambush against Temple cavalry, and Valora explicitly acknowledges Oakhaven’s effectiveness.
Elena, Valora and Bram jointly coordinate the sixth-level forge effort to create anti-siphoning charges.
Elena explicitly restates a reciprocal Human–Demon pact around medicine, Thần Tinh resources and battlefield support; Valora accepts the terms again.
Elena, Valora’s forces and Gargas continue coordinated anti-siphoning operations inside Hẻm Vực, showing the alliance functioning tactically rather than only diplomatically.
At the buffer-stream camp, Human and Demon forces share food, medical care and security duties; the alliance is narrated as normalized among rank-and-file survivors.
Valora and Elena participate in the combined assault through Solaria’s Inner Gate toward the final Temple defenses.
Valora accepts Alan and Elena into an equal anti-Temple alliance after Korgan’s rescue is verified.
Alan and Valora’s forces fight the Temple cavalry together; Valora formally recognizes the anti-mana effectiveness of Alan’s sword.
Valora deliberately draws Temple cavalry away while Alan and Elena infiltrate the western siphoning position.
Alan de-escalates a historical Human–Demon grievance at the camp and Valora reaffirms military cooperation.
Alan and Gargas execute a joint Vespera-lens sabotage under the wider Human–Demon operation.
Alan, Valora and the mixed force establish a common staging camp and plan the Solaria infiltration.
Alan and Valora’s combined forces breach the Inner Gate and advance toward the Great Cathedral/Origin Altar.
Elena treats Gargas’s siphoning-contaminated wound without mana; after recovery he says he owes the humans a life.
Gargas fights as Alan and Elena’s tactical partner; narration explicitly links the cooperation to Elena’s earlier medical rescue, though the chronology still contains a relationship reset.
Gargas joins Alan and Elena in cutting the Vespera siphoning cables around the Earth Vein Core.

relationships.notes: Gargas already appeared in chapter 31 as the commander who accepted Korgan’s token; chapter 44 partly resets his distrust, so the relationship delta is canonical locally but chronology is flagged.

history.change: Sael gives Alan a slum resistance map and commits his network to rise once the pressure pillar at the commercial crossroads is destroyed.
Sael’s fighters mobilize after Alan’s team destroys the pillar.
Sael and Alan’s allied force capture the outer arsenal and arm the slum fighters.
Sael’s team helps plant Thần Tinh charges on the Inner Gate hinges during the assault.
Elena joins Sael’s plan for an uprising and contributes non-mana concealment/medical methods to the safehouse operation.
Elena’s chemical disruption helps trigger the pillar sabotage that activates Sael’s uprising.
Elena directs chemical weakening of the Inner Gate mechanism while Sael’s fighters place charges.
